title: Sniper Solo Queue Strategy - Niche Playstyle
content:
## Sniper Solo Queue Strategy

A unconventional approach to ranking up as sniper main.

### Core Strategy
- **Hide**: Stay concealed
- **Wait**: Patience is key
- **Move**: Relocate after each shot

### Loadout
- Primary: Bolt-action + silencer
- Secondary: SMG for close range
- Gear: Camo + noise reduction

### Tips
- Use high ground positions
- Coordinate with team pings
- Know when to switch weapons

title: M4A1 Advanced Build Guide
content:
## M4A1 Best Build Configuration

The M4A1 is versatile but needs the right attachments.

### All-Rounder Build
- **Barrel**: Long barrel (range + accuracy)
- **Grip**: Vertical (reduces vertical recoil)
- **Sight**: Red dot or holographic
- **Mag**: Extended mag

### Precision Build
- **Barrel**: Heavy barrel (max accuracy)
- **Grip**: Angled (reduces horizontal recoil)
- **Sight**: 4x scope
- **Stock**: Stable stock

### Recoil Control
- First 10 rounds are very stable
- Slightly pull down after 10 rounds
- Practice burst firing
- Use cover to peek-shoot
